name: LukeLauncher
blurb: LukeLauncher is a fast, minimal, categorie based home screen replacement.
description:
LukeLauncher is a fast, minimal, categorie based home screen replacement.

-------------------------------------------------
LukeLauncher – Features
-------------------------------------------------

• Apps are managed in categories
• Suitable for left and right handers
• Notifications are supported
• Widgets are supported
• Supports Tablets (Horizontal and vertical alignment possible)
• Quick search function
• Iconpacks can be used
• Multilingual (English, German, Spanish and Czech)
… and much much more!

Website:
https://lukelauncher.de
